name: Oasis
atmos: A desert oasis, and the inside of a Dubai chocolate bar
lens: Arabic-contemporary lens · storytelling in the spirit of Mythology
roots: Caravans stopped at oases to replenish water and food. Al-Ahsa, the world's largest, holds about 2.5 million date palms.
https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/1563/
Kunafa's origin is disputed (Palestine, Egypt, Syria). A common account places it in the 10th-century Fatimid court, and Nablus is the touchstone.
https://www.cadburydessertscorner.com/articles/tracing-the-origins-of-kunafa-the-popular-middle-eastern-dessert
Fix Dessert Chocolatier launched the pistachio-kunafa bar in Dubai in 2021. One TikTok passed 80M+ views, and the founder reports 30,000 orders in an hour.
https://officialfixdessertchocolatier.com/blogs/news/who-is-sarah-hamouda-meet-the-woman-behind-dubais-viral-chocolate-bar
so: Laza becomes the oasis on 5th Avenue: the 2am rest stop where water and something sweet arrive before you ask. The wordmark stretches like a kashida stroke, a caravan road. The symbol is the dallah, the coffee pot of welcome. The WOW moment is a counter built like a cross-section of the chocolate bar: layers you can see, a crunch you can hear.
wm_note: Kashida stretch between z and a · one color: Clay
sym_note: The dallah, a round Arabic coffee pot · clay, saffron, olive
scheme: Analogous warms with an olive counterpoint
contrast: Date on Sand 7.9:1 · Clay on Sand 3.2:1, display only.
voice: We pull it from the oven when it's ready, not when the timer says.
service: Every guest gets a glass of water and one date on arrival, the oasis welcome. Linen shirts in sand, aprons in olive.

01: A still pool under a round skylight, two date palms, and low oak benches around it. People sit close, the light is late-afternoon gold at any hour, and nobody rushes you.
11: Clay limewash curves into soft niches. A shallow water channel leads the eye to the chocolate-layered counter at the back. Woven palm-fibre lamps keep it warm after dark.
02: The WOW: a counter you can taste
The counter is a cross-section of a Dubai chocolate bar: chocolate plaster, a pistachio band and a golden kataifi crunch layer. The bar on top is cut to show the same layers.
12: A sunken nook of low oak platforms and saffron cushions, made for the 20-minute hang. Mint tea glasses, dates and kunafa on a low round table.
03: Sand linen and an olive apron. The first thing the host offers is water and a single date, before you order.
04: Sand cups with a terracotta lid, carrying the one-color clay wordmark. Nothing else on the cup.
05: Terracotta plates, olive-glazed bowls and the round kunafa tray. Made to be handled, and warm to the touch.
06: A sand canvas tote and an olive cap. Worn on a normal day, not only as a souvenir.
07: One photo, one line: "Rest here." The crunch sells itself.
08: A clay-plaster façade, an oak door and a potted date palm. The sign is the wordmark in relief.

name: Teta
atmos: Grandma's kitchen, and a Turkish esnaf lokanta
lens: Brooklyn lens · human, neighborhood-proud, in the spirit of Red Antler
roots: 'Ahlan wa sahlan' joins ahl (family) and sahl (easy path): you are family, and may your way be easy.
https://speakrealarabic.com/post/ahlan-wa-sahlan-meaning-levantine-arabic
Hospitality (karam) is treated as a sacred obligation, rooted in the Bedouin ethic of caring for travelers.
https://www.arabiclanguageonline.com/blog/arabic-coffee-culture/
The esnaf lokantası is a tradesmen's canteen with a steam table of ready dishes, often family-run, with staff of 20 or more years. The principle is that you should feel at home.
https://www.theguideistanbul.com/istanbul-lokanta-culture/
so: Teta (grandmother) feeds you before you ask, and the lokanta keeps the trays warm and visible. The brand is a name-tag, not a crest: a friendly Ruq'ah-cut wordmark with one diamond dot, and a round Turkish teapot for the symbol. The room is the tray wall: loud, warm, and tiled like a kitchen.
wm_note: Ruq'ah teardrop terminals and one nuqta dot · one color: Pomegranate
sym_note: Turkish double teapot and a tulip glass · pomegranate, saffron, indigo
scheme: Triadic: red, yellow, blue; indigo always sits with oak and saffron
contrast: Indigo on Ivory 8.4:1 · Pomegranate on Ivory 5.5:1.
voice: A second plate, whether you asked or not.
No one leaves hungry. It's a rule.
service: Guests are served first, and regulars are greeted by name. The team wears pomegranate aprons with indigo trim and a small embroidered teapot on the chest.

01: Indigo and ivory tile, a steam-table counter full of trays, open shelves of mismatched china, and long shared oak tables. It's loud in the best way.
11: Hanging trays and wooden ma'amoul moulds line the wall behind an open kitchen, over a big family table with mismatched chairs. You can see and smell everything being made.
02: A glass-fronted warm counter of round trays: kunafa, baklava, ma'amoul and qatayef. Every slice is served with a pull of cheese.
12: An ivory-tiled banquette with pomegranate cushions by the street window. Tea glasses, a newspaper, and two friends splitting a plate.
03: Ivory shirt, pomegranate apron and indigo trim. The job is to make you feel like family in the first ten seconds.
04: Ivory cups with a pomegranate sleeve, carrying the one-color wordmark and its single diamond dot.
05: Enamel plates with an indigo rim and pomegranate bowls. The platter carries the brand symbol, as if it came from Teta's cupboard.
06: Tea towel, enamel mug and tote. Kitchen things people actually use.
07: "Teta says: eat." Grandma's hands, one square of kunafa, on the subway.
08: An indigo tile façade and a pomegranate awning. The window full of trays is the sign.

name: Aegean
atmos: The Turkish coastline, from Bodrum to Kaş
lens: Northern-European lens · restraint in the spirit of Koto
roots: 'Ultramarine' is Middle Latin for 'beyond the sea'. The pigment came from lapis mined in Badakhshan, Afghanistan, and was once worth more than gold in Europe.
https://storiedcolors.com/color/ultramarine/
In Bodrum, walls are whitewashed against insects and windows are painted blue against the evil eye, with bougainvillea over the doors.
https://www.hurriyetdailynews.com/bodrums-white-against-insects-blue-against-the-evil-eye-117393
Maraş dondurma is stretchy ice cream made with salep and mastic. Its vendors turn serving into a playful street show.
https://www.cnn.com/travel/maras-dondurma-turkish-ice-cream
so: The blue has come a long way, and so has Laza, from the Levant to Astoria. A heavy, calm, generously spaced wordmark with one crescent-cut counter. The symbol is a round maraş cone with a drooping scoop. The ritual is the stretch-and-flip at the ice-cream counter, modernized: striped linen, not a costume.
wm_note: Crescent-cut counter in the final a · one color: Ultramarine
sym_note: Round maraş cone with a drooping scoop · ultramarine, violet, apricot
scheme: Split-complementary: blue-violet against apricot, grounded by oak
contrast: Ultramarine on Chalk 7.3:1 · Lapis Ink on Apricot 6.4:1.
voice: Stretch it. Flip it. Eat it.
The lights go violet at eleven.
service: A stretch-and-flip moment at the ice-cream counter. The team wears ultramarine-and-white striped linen with an apricot neckerchief.

01: Lime-white walls, ultramarine doors and shutters, and bougainvillea overhead. Cobalt glass lamps hang over long oak tables. It feels like a house in Bodrum, on a Queens street.
11: Oak beams, the ultramarine tile counter along one side and a long communal table. The light stays calm and sea-bright into the evening.
02: Maraş-style ice cream is pulled high on a steel paddle while the guest reaches for the cone. It's the moment people film.
12: Whitewashed stepped seating with striped cushions and apricot side tables, under violet bougainvillea. Built for dusk.
03: Ultramarine-and-white striped linen and an apricot neckerchief. Crisp, relaxed and coastal.
04: A white cup with an ultramarine lid and a violet froyo cup. The one-color wordmark does all the work.
05: White plates with an ultramarine rim, cobalt glass tumblers and violet-glazed bowls of apricots, in hard Aegean sunlight.
06: A violet cap and an ultramarine tote, from a rooftop by the sea.
07: "Beyond the sea. Open till 2am." One scoop, one petal, one blue.
08: A whitewash and ultramarine façade with bougainvillea planters, and apricot light spilling out at dusk.

name: Island
atmos: A tropical island, on Brooklyn hours
lens: LA lens · sunny, social and content-first in the spirit of Media.Monks
roots: Tiki began in 1933–34 in Hollywood and Oakland as a fantasy tropics, and is now widely critiqued as cultural appropriation. So there are no masks, no totems and no pseudo-Polynesian type.
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tiki_culture
Mango kunafa (kataifi, mango, cream, rose syrup) is an established modern twist that spread on TikTok and Instagram.
https://amiraspantry.com/knafeh-mango-cream/
Island time means slowness and sun. Laza's version is the unhurried 20-minute hang Moose asked for. (inference)
so: Baby blue is the sky and the sea: the primary color, the one Moose asked for. Mango is the warm core that makes it sing. The escape comes from the fruit, the light and the pace, not a costume. A bubbly wordmark whose l curls like a Naskh stroke, and a round mango-kunafa symbol.
wm_note: Naskh-curl l, bubbly terminals · one color: Cornflower
sym_note: Round mango kunafa with a leaf · mango, coral, leaf green
scheme: Baby blue leads; mango is the warm core; coral and oak warm it further
contrast: Deep Blue on Baby Blue 6.3:1 · on Mango 6.2:1 · on Sky Wash 9.7:1.
type: Pick a side, or take both.
voice: Cold froyo, hot kunafa. Pick a side, or take both.
service: Nobody rushes you, and the specials follow the fruit. The team wears blue camp-collar shirts with mango aprons.

01: Blue tile, an oak deck-plank floor, rattan chairs, slow fans and banana plants. Friends lounge over mango desserts at 2pm, all year.
11: Baby-blue tile and ceiling, a curved oak bar with rattan stools, mango-yellow lamps and a coral terrazzo floor. Late afternoon, every afternoon.
02: An oak counter piled with ripe mangoes, mango hedgehog cuts and trays of mango kunafa. The fruit is the decoration.
12: A built-in oak daybed with blue and mango striped cushions. Put your feet up; it's island time.
03: A blue camp-collar shirt and a mango apron. Sunny, relaxed and quick to smile.
04: A cream cup with a blue lid and a mango froyo cup, carrying the curled-l wordmark.
05: Coral and cream speckled plates and blue-glazed bowls under palm-leaf shadows. The symbol is stamped on the plate.
06: A striped beach-towel tote and a mango cap, on a sunny Brooklyn sidewalk.
07: "Island time. Brooklyn hours." Mango kunafa, one bite missing.
08: A tiled façade, oak frames, a coral-and-cream awning and banana plants by the door.

name: Yalla
atmos: Sunny yellow first, blue second: Laza's own La La Land
lens: New York lens · pop, social and joyful, a merge of Brooklyn warmth and LA energy
roots: Moose's emotional model is La La Land's yellow: one saturated color carrying the feeling across costume and set. Here the yellow is mango-warm, not lemon.
'Yalla' is the everyday Arabic for 'come on, let's go'. It is used from Beirut to Brooklyn and is instantly social. (inference)
The ma'amoul, a round, stamped, shared cookie, is the holiday sweet of Levantine homes. It becomes the symbol. (inference)
so: Yellow is the mood and blue is the promise Moose asked for. Together they're the happiest pairing on the color wheel: yellow-orange against blue. A round, thick, generously spaced wordmark with a floating dot and a flick. The room is sunlight you can walk into, day or 1am.
wm_note: Floating nuqta over the z and a soft flick on the a · one color: Cornflower on Sun
sym_note: The round ma'amoul · mango yellow, cornflower, oak
scheme: Complementary: sunny yellow-orange with cornflower blue, grounded by oak
contrast: Navy on Sun 8.7:1 · Navy on Cream 13.3:1 · Cornflower on Sun 3.1:1, logo and display only.
voice: Come for dessert. Stay for the mood.
service: Music up after 9pm and a kunafa-pull show on the hour. The team wears sun-yellow jackets over blue tees, with oak aprons.

01: Sun-yellow walls and ceiling, a long cornflower-tiled counter with an oak top, and chrome stools. People of every age sit close. This is the La La Land feeling, built as a room.
11: Oak stepped seating under a yellow barrel ceiling, with a cornflower kunafa bar across the room. Friends and families share the steps.
02: The WOW: the pull under the sun
A round cornflower-tiled kunafa bar under a huge yellow dome light. The cheese pull happens on the hour, and everyone films it.
12: An oak window counter facing the street, with glowing yellow walls behind. The best seat in Brooklyn at 1am.
03: A sun-yellow work jacket over a blue tee, with an oak apron. Energetic, never loud.
04: A yellow cup with a blue lid and a blue froyo cup. The wordmark flips color so both cups read as Laza.
05: Yellow enamel plates, blue bowls and a blue Turkish teapot with tulip glasses, on an oak tray of ma'amoul and qatayef.
06: A yellow hoodie and a blue tote on a Brooklyn stoop. Merch that works as a uniform for the regulars.
07: "Yalla. Good mood, open till 2am." Friends mid-laugh, on the subway.
08: A sun-yellow façade on 5th Avenue under a cornflower awning. It glows at golden hour and at midnight.
